title: [Performance][v0.32.0rc] Avoid per-element tracking for contiguous UVA writes
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
Reduce MRV2 UVA fallback dirty-tracking overhead:
- Track contiguous prefix writes with a single bound instead of creating per-element indices and invoking per-element callbacks.
- Support multidimensional NumPy and Tensor prefix slices, including `[:n, :]` and `[:n, 0]`.
- Copy any contiguous dirty range with an asynchronous pinned slice copy, including nonzero-start ranges outside a dirty prefix.
- Preserve mixed prefix/sparse writes, uint64 bit patterns, real-UVA behavior, and upstream buffer-pool lifetime and rotation.

The pool test retains `pool._uva_bufs[pool._curr]`: the paired vLLM implementation advances the index before selecting and writing the slot.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
Reduces CPU request-admission overhead for long prompts without adding configuration or changing tensor contents.

### How was this patch tested?
- 13 focused unit tests passed, including multidimensional prefix slices and nonzero-start contiguous ranges. The latter verifies that contiguous synchronization does not fall back to indexed copy or re-pinning.
- 14 real-NPU tests passed on Ascend 950, covering buffer-pool growth and rotation, NumPy/Tensor/list inputs, uint64 high bits, and multidimensional prefix/contiguous-range mixing.
- AISBench steady-state throughput improved by **15.39%** in the deployment-level comparison.
- With this optimization and P/D static kernel disabled, GPQA Diamond completed all 198 requests with zero request failures: **90.91% (180/198 correct)**. This is combined-stack validation, not an isolated accuracy attribution. A separate static-enabled GPQA attempt encountered a P-side MoE Dispatch timeout and is invalid.
- Hardware and end-to-end evidence was collected on the deployed development stack; pristine target-branch integration remains subject to CI.
- Ruff lint/format and `git diff --check` passed. Full `bash format.sh ci` was attempted in isolated target-branch worktrees but could not complete because pre-commit tool-environment installation stalled; full hook validation remains for CI.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
